headline: Ukraine Awaits US Date For Next Peace Talks With Russia
label: NEWS
caption:
Ukraine is currently waiting for the United States to set a date for the next round of peace talks with Russia according to President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

Zelenskyy made the statement as diplomatic efforts continue to find a resolution to the ongoing conflict.

No official timeline has been confirmed yet by American authorities for the upcoming diplomatic meetings.
